title: Self-Reflection on Faith and Hypocrisy
summary: This hadith emphasizes constant self-assessment of faith to prevent hypocrisy and loss of belief.
translation: One should always assess their faith to ensure there is no hidden hypocrisy within. Reliance solely on one's perceived piety may lead to complacency. Even the illustrious companions, like Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq, Hazrat Hanzala Asadi, and Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab, were deeply concerned about their faith's status, fearing its stealthy erosion. They regularly evaluated their spiritual condition and consulted the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to align their lives with his teachings and ensure worldly attachments did not weaken their faith. The greatest trial today is losing faith unknowingly, as described by Hazrat Ali (may Allah have mercy on him), especially amidst numerous trials, leading to a loss of true Islamic identity and actions. Constant vigilance over one’s faith is crucial.
